name: siteground-deploy
description: Gets a Node.js project live on SiteGround step by step: fit check, GitHub auto-deploy or ZIP upload, every dashboard click explained (environment variables, database, cron, SSH key, HTTPS, domain and DNS), plus a SiteGround vs. Railway comparison. Its helper scripts create an SSH key on your machine and connect over SSH and HTTPS to your own SiteGround site to verify the deploy. German and English. Unofficial, not affiliated with SiteGround. Created by Sertac · NetBoosting GmbH (https://netboosting.de).
